definitions.gloss: Iwakura Tomomi (1825–1883), court noble and Meiji statesman
definitions.explanation: A court noble who helped bring about the restoration of imperial rule in 1867 and became one of the leaders of the Meiji government. He headed the Iwakura Mission to the United States and Europe (1871–1873).

examples.japanese: {岩倉具視|いわくらともみ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{公家|くげ}→公家：12664_kuge⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧だった。

examples.english: The old 500-yen note bore a portrait of Iwakura Tomomi.

notes:
Unlike most leaders of the Meiji Restoration, who were samurai from Satsuma and Chōshū, Iwakura was a court noble (⟦{公家|くげ}→公家：12664_kuge⟧), and his ties to the imperial court were his strength.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{岩倉|いわくら}{使節団|しせつだん}→岩倉使節団：33237_iwakurashisetsudan⟧: the Iwakura Mission (1871–1873)
- {王政復古|おうせいふっこ}: the restoration of imperial rule (1867), which he helped plan

CULTURAL NOTE:
His portrait was on the 500-yen note from 1951 until the note was replaced by a coin in the 1980s, so older Japanese know his face well.
